feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Family of footballer who died after on-pitch collision pay tribute to him
articles.summary: Family, friends and teammates gathered for the funeral of the Spanish footballer who died following an on-field collision with another player.

articles.title: Meghan's brother a 'person of interest' in child abuse image claims
articles.summary: Meghan Markle's half brother has been named as a "person of interest" in an investigation into child sexual abuse image allegations against the Duchess of Sussex's father.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo bows out from national team with emotional message
articles.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football.

articles.title: Russia attacks Ukrainian aid hub in one of the deadliest strikes since war began
articles.summary: Russian strikes on an aid hub killed at least 40 people - making it one of Russia's deadliest attacks on Ukrainian civilians since the full-scale invasion began, officials said.

articles.title: Goalkeeper involved in collision with Spanish footballer who died releases statement
articles.summary: A goalkeeper involved in an on-field collision with a Spanish footballer who died says he is "going through the most difficult ‌days of his life".

articles.title: Spanish footballer dies after on-field collision
articles.summary: Tenerife football player Jesus de Miguel has died after suffering a cardiac arrest following an on-field collision in a match on Monday.
